financials_interim.notes: COMPANY (standalone) basis, same filing/period as GROUP row -- see GROUP row's notes for shared context (TAP-GREG ownership, share split, operating_profit sourcing). Company revenue fell 23% YoY to Rs.174.300mn (2025: Rs.226.638mn); no Cost of Sales line at Company level (Gross Profit = Revenue). operating_profit taken from the filing's own printed 'Operating Profit/(Loss)' line: -Rs.172.743mn (2026) vs +Rs.716.920mn (2025) -- verified via GP(174.300)+Other Income(5.421)-Admin(52.178)+FV change(-300.286)=-172.743, ties exactly. Company FV loss of -Rs.300.286mn (2026) vs +Rs.557.412mn gain (2025) on the Company's own Rs.9,167.679mn FVTPL book (Note 8) drives the swing, similar direction to Group's -Rs.324.632mn loss (both pools moved negative together this quarter, unlike TAP's Company/Group divergence). Company Admin Expenses fell 29% YoY (Rs.52.178mn vs Rs.73.015mn). Company swung from PBT +Rs.586.253mn to -Rs.234.370mn (Rs.820.623mn swing); no tax expense either year at Company level. shares_in_issue = 1,427,478,664, same post-split register as Group. EPS cross-check: -234,369,854 / 1,427,478,664 = -0.1642 -> -0.16, ties. Identity check: total_liabilities (195.655+2,679.014=2,874.669) + total_equity (11,486.249) = 14,360.918, ties printed Total Assets 14,360.918mn exactly.

Ambeon Holdings PLC (GREG), investment holding/managing company, FYE 31 March. GROUP (consolidated) basis. Q1 FY2026/27 (period ended 30 June 2026) vs Q1 FY2025/26 (period ended 30 June 2025) comparative, both presented as single 'For The Period Ended 30 June' columns on the face P&L (page 3) -- first quarter of GREG's fiscal year (FYE 31 March), so 3-month and cumulative-YTD figures are identical, no QoQ distinction applies. OWNERSHIP: GREG is 81.43%-owned by Ambeon Capital PLC (TAP) -- directly (13.56%) plus via four bank-collateral holding accounts (Seylan 31.61%, Commercial Bank 14.46%, DFCC 12.61%, Pan Asia 9.19%), per GREG's own Note 4.4 shareholder register (page 8). TAP is therefore GREG's majority PARENT, consolidating GREG's results into its own Group accounts (this corrects a 'GREG is TAP's parent' assumption elsewhere). GREG's own segment note (Note 2, page 7) has NO Footwear/Manufacturing segment (unlike TAP's), confirming TAP's Harischandra Mills acquisition (Note 9 of TAP's filing) sits directly under TAP, outside GREG's consolidation perimeter -- GREG's 'IT and Related Services' segment revenue (Rs.3,059.949mn/Rs.3,344.821mn) is near-identical to TAP's own same-named segment, confirming this large segment sits within GREG and flows up into TAP's Group figures given the 81.43% stake. SHARE SPLIT: ordinary voting shares were subdivided 4-for-1 on 13 May 2026 (356,869,666 -> 1,427,478,664 shares, Note 4.1), with no change to Stated Capital (Rs.5,331,775,177); the 30/06/2025 comparative EPS (Note 5) was recomputed on the SAME post-split 1,427,478,664 share count for both periods, so the EPS YoY comparison is like-for-like. operating_profit taken directly from the filing's own printed 'Operating Profit/(Loss)' subtotal line (page 3, before Finance Income/Cost and before Share of Equity Accounted Investee) -- Rs.-408.555mn (2026) / Rs.669.815mn (2025); this differs from the segment note's own 'Profit/(Loss) Before Net Finance Cost' 2025 Group Total of Rs.639.868mn (Note 2), a Rs.29.947mn gap that traces to GREG's segment note computing that subtotal AFTER netting the Rs.35.792mn Share of Results of Equity Accounted Investee loss for 2025 (669.815-35.792=634.023, still Rs.5.845mn off the printed 639.868, an unreconciled residual apparent minor internal inconsistency within the segment note itself, not an extraction error on our part) -- the face-P&L 'Operating Profit/(Loss)' line is used here as the more authoritative, directly-labelled figure. REVENUE: Group revenue fell 9% YoY to Rs.3,235.293mn (2025: Rs.3,573.705mn); ALL segments declined: Investment segment -24.8% (Rs.158.700mn vs Rs.211.038mn), Property -6.7% (Rs.16.644mn vs Rs.17.847mn), IT and Related Services -8.5% (Rs.3,059.949mn vs Rs.3,344.821mn, ~95% of Group revenue -- the dominant driver of the overall decline in absolute terms). Gross margin compressed from 15.5% (555.516/3573.705) to 10.9% (351.519/3235.293) -- Cost of Sales fell only 4% (Rs.2,883.774mn vs Rs.3,018.190mn) versus revenue's 9% fall, i.e. cost of sales did not scale down with revenue, a genuine margin driver distinct from the fair-value swing below. PROFIT: Operating Profit swung Rs.1,078.370mn negative, from +Rs.669.815mn (2025) to -Rs.408.555mn (2026); of this, the 'Change in Fair Value of Financial Assets measured at FVTPL' line alone swung Rs.937.704mn negative (-Rs.324.632mn loss 2026 vs +Rs.613.072mn gain 2025, ~87% of the Operating Profit swing) -- per Note 9, essentially ALL of the -Rs.324.632mn 2026 movement was unrealised (Unrealised loss -Rs.324.632mn vs a tiny Rs.2.330mn realised gain transferred to revenue), i.e. a mark-to-market item on the Group's Rs.9,896.269mn FVTPL quoted-equity book (Note 8), not operating/trading performance. Partly offsetting: Administrative Expenses fell 14% YoY (Rs.393.303mn vs Rs.454.980mn), a genuine cost saving. PBT swung from +Rs.505.235mn to -Rs.552.550mn (Rs.1,057.785mn swing); PAT swung from +Rs.676.891mn to -Rs.560.417mn (Rs.1,237.308mn swing). ONE-OFF IN 2025 BASE: 2025 PAT of Rs.676.891mn includes a Rs.188.393mn one-off gain from DISCONTINUED OPERATIONS with NO 2026 equivalent (2026 discontinued-ops line is nil) -- i.e. Rs.188.393mn of the higher 2025 comparator base, and hence part of the apparent YoY PAT decline, reflects the absence of a repeat one-off gain rather than a decline in continuing operations; PAT FROM CONTINUING OPERATIONS ALONE swung from +Rs.488.499mn (2025) to -Rs.560.417mn (2026), a Rs.1,048.916mn continuing-ops swing, still overwhelmingly explained by the FV loss above. Tax expense fell 53% YoY (Rs.7.866mn vs Rs.16.736mn), a mechanical consequence of the swing to a loss. BALANCE SHEET: total_liabilities = Non-Current (1,159.088) + Current (14,889.895) = 16,048.983mn, ties exactly to the segment note's own printed Group Total Liabilities (16,048,983th). trade_payables = 'Trade and Other Payables' (4,648.239mn) as printed, a combined line. cash_from_investing (1,799.913mn, a net inflow) and capex (16.262mn, 'Acquisition of Property, Plant & Equipment', gross) taken as printed. shares_in_issue = 1,427,478,664 (post-split, Note 4.1/5). EPS cross-check: -448,970,801 / 1,427,478,664 = -0.3145 -> -0.31, ties. Identity check: total_liabilities (16,048.983) + total_equity (12,931.290) = 28,980.273, ties printed Total Assets 28,980.273mn exactly.

interim_updates.note_text: Ambeon Holdings PLC (GREG), investment holding/managing company (Group segments: Investment, Property, IT and Related Services, Financial Services -- no Manufacturing/Footwear segment, unlike parent TAP), reported a Group net loss of Rs.560.417mn for Q1 FY2026/27 (period ended 30 June 2026), reversing a Rs.676.891mn profit in Q1 FY2025/26 (period ended 30 June 2025). OWNERSHIP: GREG is 81.43%-owned by Ambeon Capital PLC (TAP) -- directly plus via four bank-collateral holding accounts, per GREG's own Note 4.4 -- making TAP the majority PARENT (this corrects a 'GREG is TAP's parent' framing elsewhere; TAP's own filing independently confirms the same 81.43% figure). Group revenue fell 9% YoY to Rs.3,235.293mn (2025: Rs.3,573.705mn); every segment declined: IT and Related Services -8.5% to Rs.3,059.949mn (2025: Rs.3,344.821mn, ~95% of Group revenue -- the dominant driver of the fall in absolute Rupee terms), Investment segment -24.8% to Rs.158.700mn (2025: Rs.211.038mn), Property -6.7% to Rs.16.644mn (2025: Rs.17.847mn). Gross margin compressed from 15.5% to 10.9% as Cost of Sales fell only 4% (Rs.2,883.774mn vs Rs.3,018.190mn) against revenue's 9% fall -- a genuine operating-margin driver distinct from the fair-value item below. Operating Profit (filing's own printed subtotal, page 3) swung Rs.1,078.370mn negative, from +Rs.669.815mn (2025) to -Rs.408.555mn (2026); of this, 'Change in Fair Value of Financial Assets measured at FVTPL' alone swung Rs.937.704mn negative (-Rs.324.632mn loss 2026 vs +Rs.613.072mn gain 2025, ~87% of the Operating Profit swing) -- per Note 9, virtually the ENTIRE -Rs.324.632mn 2026 movement was unrealised (unrealised loss -Rs.324.632mn vs a Rs.2.330mn realised gain transferred to revenue), a mark-to-market item on the Group's Rs.9,896.269mn FVTPL quoted-equity book (Note 8), not operating/trading performance. Partly offsetting: Administrative Expenses fell 14% YoY (Rs.393.303mn vs Rs.454.980mn), a genuine cost saving. PBT (continuing operations) swung from +Rs.505.235mn to -Rs.552.550mn. ONE-OFF DISTORTION IN THE 2025 BASE: reported 2025 total PAT of Rs.676.891mn includes a Rs.188.393mn one-off gain from DISCONTINUED OPERATIONS with NO 2026 equivalent -- i.e. Rs.188.393mn of the higher 2025 comparator, and hence part of the apparent YoY PAT decline, reflects the absence of a repeat one-off rather than weaker continuing operations. PAT FROM CONTINUING OPERATIONS ALONE swung from +Rs.488.499mn (2025) to -Rs.560.417mn (2026), a Rs.1,048.916mn swing, still overwhelmingly explained by the FV loss above, not the one-off. Tax expense fell 53% YoY (Rs.7.866mn vs Rs.16.736mn), mechanical given the swing to a loss.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to 30 June 2026 has been collected for GREG -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. GREG's segment note (Note 2, page 7) 'Profit/(Loss) Before Net Finance Cost' Group Total for 2025 (Rs.639.868mn) does not exactly reconcile to the face P&L's printed 'Operating Profit/(Loss)' 2025 figure (Rs.669.815mn) even after adjusting for the Rs.35.792mn Share of Results of Equity Accounted Investee -- a Rs.5.845mn residual gap appears to be a minor internal inconsistency within the segment note itself (source filing artifact, not an extraction error here); the face-P&L 'Operating Profit/(Loss)' line was used for operating_profit as the more directly-labelled, authoritative figure, and segment-level PBT was NOT separately relied upon for narrative attribution because of this discrepancy. GREG discloses no separate segment-level PBT breakdown that ties cleanly to the Financial Services segment (shown as nil/blank both years in Note 2), even though a 'Financial Services' column exists in the segment header -- this segment's revenue/results appear to sit at TAP level, not GREG level, consistent with the ownership finding above; flagged as a genuine disclosure gap rather than assumed. Company-level segment information is not disclosed at all (segment note is Group-only).
interim_updates.takeaway: GREG's swing from a Rs.676.891mn Group profit to a Rs.560.417mn Group loss in Q1 FY2026/27 was driven overwhelmingly by a Rs.937.704mn negative swing in unrealised fair value on the Group's Rs.9,896.269mn FVTPL quoted-equity book (from a Rs.613.072mn gain to a Rs.324.632mn loss, ~87% of the Rs.1,078.370mn Operating Profit deterioration), compounded by a genuine 9% revenue decline (Rs.3,235.293mn vs Rs.3,573.705mn) concentrated in the IT and Related Services segment (-8.5%, ~95% of Group revenue) and a margin squeeze as Cost of Sales fell only 4% against that 9% revenue drop. The 2025 comparator base was also flattered by a Rs.188.393mn one-off discontinued-operations gain that did not repeat in 2026, meaning even the continuing-operations comparison alone shows a Rs.1,048.916mn swing to a loss. Investors should also register that GREG is the 81.43%-owned Group subsidiary of Ambeon Capital PLC (TAP), not TAP's parent -- TAP's newly-acquired Harischandra Mills (footwear) manufacturing business sits outside GREG's own accounts.

yoy.label: Profit After Tax (Group, total incl. discontinued)

operational_highlights: Group Revenue Rs.3,235.293mn, -9% YoY (2025: Rs.3,573.705mn); Group Operating Loss Rs.408.555mn vs a Rs.669.815mn profit in 2025; Group PAT -Rs.560.417mn vs +Rs.676.891mn in 2025.

Every segment's revenue fell YoY: IT and Related Services -8.5% to Rs.3,059.949mn (2025: Rs.3,344.821mn, ~95% of Group revenue), Investment -24.8% to Rs.158.700mn (2025: Rs.211.038mn), Property -6.7% to Rs.16.644mn (2025: Rs.17.847mn).

Change in Fair Value of FVTPL financial assets swung Rs.937.704mn negative YoY, from a Rs.613.072mn gain (2025) to a Rs.324.632mn loss (2026) -- per Note 9, Rs.322.302mn of the 2026 total FV movement of -Rs.324.632mn was unrealised, on a Rs.9,896.269mn Group FVTPL book -- the single largest driver of the swing to an operating loss.

Gross margin compressed from 15.5% to 10.9% as Cost of Sales fell only 4% (Rs.2,883.774mn vs Rs.3,018.190mn) versus revenue's 9% decline; Administrative Expenses fell 14% YoY (Rs.393.303mn vs Rs.454.980mn), a partial offset.
2025's Rs.676.891mn reported PAT included a Rs.188.393mn one-off gain from discontinued operations with no 2026 repeat; PAT from continuing operations alone swung from +Rs.488.499mn to -Rs.560.417mn.

Company (standalone) revenue -23% YoY to Rs.174.300mn (2025: Rs.226.638mn); Company PBT swung from +Rs.586.253mn to -Rs.234.370mn, driven by a Company-level FV loss of -Rs.300.286mn (2025: +Rs.557.412mn gain) on its own Rs.9,167.679mn FVTPL book.
key_drivers: Fair value swing on Group FVTPL financial assets: -Rs.324.632mn loss (2026, of which -Rs.322.302mn unrealised per Note 9) vs +Rs.613.072mn gain (2025), a Rs.937.704mn negative swing = ~87% of the total Rs.1,078.370mn Operating Profit deterioration -- a mark-to-market item on a Rs.9,896.269mn quoted-equity book, not a trading/operating driver.

IT and Related Services segment revenue -8.5% YoY to Rs.3,059.949mn (2025: Rs.3,344.821mn) -- accounts for ~95% of Group revenue, so even a moderate percentage decline in this single segment explains most of the Rs.338.412mn absolute Group revenue fall.

Cost of Sales fell only 4% (Rs.2,883.774mn vs Rs.3,018.190mn) against revenue's 9% decline, compressing gross margin from 15.5% to 10.9% -- a genuine operating cost-scaling issue separate from the FV swing.

One-off Rs.188.393mn discontinued-operations gain present in the 2025 comparator PAT with no 2026 equivalent -- inflates the apparent YoY PAT decline; excluding it, the continuing-operations PAT swing (+Rs.488.499mn to -Rs.560.417mn, Rs.1,048.916mn) is still the more representative comparison and remains dominated by the FV loss above.
